tasks.title: Redesign SearchFilter: remove search bar, expand to 10 wrapping intent pills, update tests
tasks.objective: Replace the SearchFilter component's text search bar and 7 horizontal-scrolling intent pills with 10 flex-wrapping intent-only pills. Update matching logic for new and renamed intents. Rewrite tests to cover the new behavior and remove obsolete search-bar assertions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The component renders all 10 intent pill buttons with correct labels: Swimming, Water sports, Dog friendly, Sunset, Sports, Bonfire, Quiet escape, Family day, Picnic, Cycling / walking
The component does not render a text input element (search bar removed)
The pill container uses flex-wrap layout instead of overflow-x-auto horizontal scroll
Tapping the Water sports pill calls onFilter with only beaches whose activities include kayaking, paddleboarding, sailing, windsurfing, or kiteboarding
Tapping two pills calls onFilter with only beaches matching both intents (AND logic)
When no pills are active, onFilter is called with all 9 beach IDs
When no pills are active, the 'Showing X of Y' counter is not rendered

tasks.technical_notes: This is a single-component refactor touching 2 files. In SearchFilter.tsx: (1) Remove 'search' useState, Search/X icon imports from lucide-react, the entire text input JSX block, and text-based filtering in useMemo. (2) Expand IntentKey union to: 'swimming' | 'waterSports' | 'dogFriendly' | 'sunset' | 'sports' | 'bonfire' | 'quiet' | 'family' | 'picnic' | 'cycling'. Rename 'dogWalk' to 'dogFriendly'. (3) Update INTENTS array with 10 entries using new labels (see TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md intent table). (4) Rewrite matchesIntent with expanded logic per TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md intent table -- notably: swimming now also matches 'pool swimming' and 'wading'; waterSports is new; dogFriendly replaces dogWalk; sports no longer matches 'kiteboarding' (moved to waterSports); bonfire now also matches activities 'bonfires'; quiet uses positive activity-based matching instead of negative amenity heuristic; family adds OR with activities 'playground'; picnic and cycling are new. (5) Change pill container class from 'overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-hide' to 'flex-wrap'. (6) Simplify hasFilters to activeIntents.size > 0. In SearchFilter.test.tsx: Delete the 4 old negative-assertion tests (sand colors, ocean colors, 2 inline SVG checks) and the old 'renders all intent filter pills' test. Write new tests for all 7 acceptance criteria. NON-SCOPE: Do not modify any files listed in TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md Non-Scope Declaration (beaches.ts, beach types, Discover.tsx, AllBeachesSection, RecommendedSection, HeroSection, BeachMap, NewsletterSignup, BeachCard, API endpoints, worker functions).
